preparations.speaker: caelan
preparations.text: Was something wrong with the chair over there?

preparations.speaker: serene
preparations.text: Caelan, would you meet our visitors by the brook? Bring them here when they're ready. I'd rather not leave all this unattended.

preparations.speaker: caelan
preparations.text: Of course. How many are coming?

preparations.speaker: serene
preparations.text: Four, according to the letter. I've prepared for six.

preparations.speaker: tomas
preparations.text: Do we have to bow when he gets here?

preparations.speaker: tomas
preparations.text: (relieved) Good. I didn't want to be the only one doing it.

preparations.speaker: serene
preparations.text: Tomas, leave the chair there for now. Help me with these cups.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: Regent Aldric? Mother Serene sent me.

arrival.speaker: aldric
arrival.text: Ah. Thank you. Have we kept her waiting?

arrival.speaker: aldric
arrival.text: (with a small, relieved laugh) Then perhaps our timing isn't quite as bad as I feared.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: I'm Caelan. I'll show you the way.

arrival.speaker: aldric
arrival.text: Thank you, Caelan. I heard Halden was having trouble with his mill.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: We've just got it working again.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: With Mira. There was a limb caught at the intake.

arrival.speaker: aldric
arrival.text: (his concern easing) Good. He'll have enough work before the festival without that.

arrival.speaker: aldric
arrival.text: Then let's not keep our hosts waiting.

dispute.speaker: venn_father
dispute.text: No. Listen to me. I agreed to a day.

dispute.speaker: road_foreman
dispute.text: We spent half of it waiting for the stone.

dispute.speaker: venn_father
dispute.text: I know. I was here.

dispute.speaker: road_foreman
dispute.text: Then you know why we haven't finished.

dispute.speaker: venn_father
dispute.text: (his temper rising) And you know why I need my cart back!

dispute.speaker: road_foreman
dispute.text: My lord. I hadn't seen you there.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: Please, go on. What was agreed?

dispute.speaker: venn_father
dispute.text: The cart for yesterday. Back by evening.

dispute.speaker: road_foreman
dispute.text: For the stone haul. The delivery was delayed.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: Was there an agreement to keep it longer?

dispute.speaker: road_foreman
dispute.text: No. I expected we'd be finished before he needed it.

dispute.speaker: regent_clerk
dispute.text: The hire note gives yesterday. There isn't an extension.

dispute.speaker: venn_father
dispute.text: My grain's ready. I've already lost time waiting for the mill.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: Is it taking deliveries again?

dispute.speaker: caelan
dispute.text: Yes. Halden's working through what was waiting.

dispute.speaker: venn_father
dispute.text: Which is why I'd like to get there before everyone else does.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: The hire has ended. Return the cart.

dispute.speaker: road_foreman
dispute.text: Then I'll need another hire, or another day. The men still need paying while they wait.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: Put the additional cost in the road account.

dispute.speaker: road_foreman
dispute.text: That leaves less for the upper section.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: (rubbing his brow) I understand. Send me the revised figures. We'll deal with that separately.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: What can the crew do while you arrange the transport?

dispute.speaker: road_foreman
dispute.text: We can prepare the bedding along the lower stretch. It changes the order of the work, but we can start there.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: Then do that. Mr. Venn, would you consider another hire once your delivery is finished?

dispute.speaker: venn_father
dispute.text: Perhaps. I've other things waiting.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: Then it will need another agreement.

dispute.speaker: venn_father
dispute.text: Thank you. And—well. I wasn't trying to hold up the road.

dispute.speaker: aldric
dispute.text: I didn't think you were.

dispute.speaker: venn_father
dispute.text: (exhaling) Right. Can I take it now?

dispute.speaker: road_foreman
dispute.text: Yes. We'll clear the way.

welcome.speaker: serene
welcome.text: There you are. Sit down before it all goes cold.

welcome.speaker: aldric
welcome.text: I'm sorry. We stopped at the road crew.

welcome.speaker: aldric
welcome.text: It should be now. There'll be another account for me to read tomorrow.

welcome.speaker: serene
welcome.text: Eat something first. You can worry about tomorrow afterward.

welcome.speaker: tomas
welcome.text: Did you come all the way over the ridge in that wagon?

welcome.speaker: aldric
welcome.text: (laughing) After sitting in it all morning, I was glad to.

welcome.speaker: regent_driver
welcome.text: He made better time than we did, too.

welcome.speaker: serene
welcome.text: Have some bread. All of you. Caelan, would you pass that plate?

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: I've looked at the survey again. The proposed cuts are well clear of the sanctuary buildings.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: They're still inside the protected boundary.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: I know. That is why I'm asking.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: And I'm trying to explain why the distance from the buildings doesn't settle it. The covenant protects the ground beneath them too.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: The stone the crew was waiting for comes from three days away. There is a nearer seam on the survey.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: Within that boundary.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: Yes. I need someone to explain what it protects.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: I can tell you what the covenant requires. I can't give you a complete account of why every boundary was drawn.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: That is what I keep being told.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: I know.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: Meanwhile, every additional journey costs money that could have repaired something else.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: I understand that it's costing more.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: More money. More time. Work left unfinished elsewhere.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: Yes.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: (frustration showing) Then I need more than another letter telling me to wait.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: I'm sorry. You have answered my letters.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: (quietly) I'm frustrated too. I would like to give you something more useful.

discussion.speaker: caelan
discussion.text: May I ask what the work would involve?

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: A preliminary excavation to examine the seam. The surveyors propose working in the ridge, clear of the buildings.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: But within the protected ground. That is the part we still disagree about.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: I will request the relevant records and ask for a joint review. Your surveyors should be able to put their questions directly to the order.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: How soon could that happen?

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: I can send the request today. I can't promise when they'll answer.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: (wearily) Everyone needs more time.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: I know you're tired of hearing it.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: Please send it. And let me know when you have a reply.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: I will. I am still not endorsing excavation on what we know today.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: I understand your answer. Thank you for hearing me out.

aftermath.speaker: serene
aftermath.text: He had an answer he could give Mr. Venn.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: And you couldn't give him one.

aftermath.speaker: serene
aftermath.text: (after a moment) Not the one he wanted. I still owe him the answer I promised.

aftermath.speaker: tomas
aftermath.text: Caelan? Can you come and look at the lanterns?

aftermath.speaker: serene
aftermath.text: Go and help him. We still have a festival to get ready for.

preparations_after.speaker: serene
preparations_after.text: The food will be ready when you bring the visitors.

arrival_reminder.speaker: aldric
arrival_reminder.text: Lead the way, Caelan. I'll follow you.

dispute_after_venn.speaker: venn_father
dispute_after_venn.text: I'm sorry you had to stand through that.

dispute_after_venn.speaker: caelan
dispute_after_venn.text: I was only bringing him to lunch.

dispute_after_venn.speaker: venn_father
dispute_after_venn.text: Then I hope you get yours. I'd better get this grain to Halden.

dispute_after_foreman.speaker: road_foreman
dispute_after_foreman.text: We'll start on the bedding. I still have to find another cart for the stone.

dispute_after_foreman.speaker: road_foreman
dispute_after_foreman.text: So do I. Mind the tools as you pass.

hospitality_after.speaker: tomas
hospitality_after.text: I thought he'd have someone carry everything for him.

hospitality_after.speaker: caelan
hospitality_after.text: He still has to sit in the wagon.

hospitality_after.speaker: tomas
hospitality_after.text: I suppose. I'd like to see that ridge road for myself.

aldric_after.speaker: aldric
aldric_after.text: Thank you for bringing us here, Caelan. I'll see you at the festival.

serene_after.speaker: serene
serene_after.text: I have a letter to write. Tomas could use your help with the lanterns.

driver_after.speaker: regent_driver
driver_after.text: If you're looking at the brake, keep your fingers clear of the catch. It closes harder than it looks.

clerk_after.speaker: regent_clerk
clerk_after.text: I'll send the revised hire terms to the foreman.

venn_waiting.speaker: venn_father
venn_waiting.text: I agreed to a day. I need my cart back.

foreman_waiting.speaker: road_foreman
foreman_waiting.text: I need to speak with the regent when he has a moment.

clerk_waiting.speaker: regent_clerk
clerk_waiting.text: We've still to reach the sanctuary. Is Serene expecting us?

tomas_waiting.speaker: tomas
tomas_waiting.text: I'm trying to get these chairs ready before everyone arrives.
